bull.point: Paint industry grew 48.7%, beating the 25% guidance, confirming strong demand.
Paint business delivered 23% growth, exceeding the 20% full-year guidance.
Operating cash flow was 1.43× PAT, ensuring high cash conversion.
Debt/equity of 0.06 indicates a nearly debt-free balance sheet.

bear.point: EBITDA margin fell 3.8 pp YoY to 13.2%, indicating cost pressure.
PAT declined 5.9% despite 26.1% revenue growth, showing margin erosion.
Analysts questioned aggressive pricing versus competition, risking future volume share.
Analysts worried about inventory losses if PVC prices fall, threatening margins.
